final_recommendation: The room converged on a liquidity-only rescue: SNB activates emergency liquidity facility (CHF 50-60B initial capacity) backed by Federal Council CHF 100B guarantee with Parliamentary preauthorization for automatic extension beyond CHF 60B. AT1 subordination locked in public statement. Credit Suisse survives as standalone bank. Statement delayed to 19:30 Sunday to secure legal anchors.
minority_objections: Wealth client repeatedly demanded explicit deposit protection above CHF 100B and questioned whether Parliament extension would execute fast enough Monday morning
AT1 rep insisted AT1 subordination language must appear in public Sunday statement, not just internal delegation documents, to prevent Monday litigation
CS CEO resisted any 'rescue' messaging, demanding standalone-bank framing to avoid confidence collapse
key_conflicts: Federal Council vs. AT1 rep/wealth client: whether AT1 subordination language belongs in public Sunday statement or only internal legal documents
SNB vs. Federal Council: whether to disclose stressed lending capacity (CHF 38-40B under volatility) Sunday or let market discover it Monday
FINMA vs. Federal Council: whether to announce guarantee before Parliamentary preauthorization was locked in writing
CS CEO vs. all regulators: framing as 'stabilization' vs. 'rescue' — CEO demanded no rescue language in client communications
key_concessions: Federal Council delayed statement from 18:00 to 19:30 to secure Parliamentary delegation in writing
Federal Council agreed to publish SNB's stressed capacity range (CHF 50-60B) in Sunday statement despite transparency risk
Federal Council added explicit AT1 subordination language to public 19:30 statement after UBS CEO demand
SNB agreed to publish draw amount at 07:00 Monday (full transparency) rather than withhold it
Federal Council capped guarantee at CHF 100B with Parliamentary extension rather than unlimited backstop
red_lines: Federal Council: will not commit taxpayer funds beyond CHF 100B without Parliamentary vote
SNB: will not lend beyond CHF 50-60B without Federal guarantee activation
AT1 rep: AT1 must take losses before depositors in any resolution scenario — no negotiation of creditor hierarchy
Wealth client: deposits must be 'fully protected' in writing or will move CHF 2B to UBS/Pictet Monday
FINMA: cannot announce package without clear legal basis (Article 36 vs Article 25) locked before market open
CS CEO: no 'rescue' language in public messaging — must frame as standalone stabilization
ignored_or_underweighted_risks: Litigation risk from AT1 holders filing injunction during 60-minute extension window Monday morning — raised by wealth client in R10 but not addressed with mitigation plan
Gap between CS CEO's scripted client calls ('unconditional protection,' 'Federal guarantee') and actual legal commitments — FINMA noted this creates legal exposure but no corrective action taken
Risk that 8-10% Monday volatility reduces SNB capacity to CHF 35-40B, burning through half the guarantee before Parliament can react — discussed extensively but no contingency beyond 'hope it holds'
Counterparty and institutional client flight (vs. wealth deposits) — never surfaced despite being a major contagion vector
Operational execution risk of 60-minute extension timeline under Monday stress — questioned but not stress-tested or rehearsed
downstream_risk_variables: Monday market volatility: if >8% adverse move, SNB capacity drops to CHF 35-40B, triggering guarantee draw before 09:00
Deposit flight velocity: if outflow exceeds CHF 80B by Monday 10:00, guarantee is half-spent and Parliamentary extension must execute flawlessly
AT1 litigation: if holders file injunction between 07:05 alert and 08:05 extension execution, drawdown timeline breaks
Client interpretation of 'unconditional protection': CS CEO's scripted calls overstate legal commitments, creating Tuesday backlash risk if clients discover gap
Parliamentary execution speed: if Finance Committee sign-off slips past 08:05 Monday, deposits 60-100B sit unprotected during run
uncertainty_notes: Parliamentary preauthorization secured at 16:45 Sunday but actual Monday execution speed (committee sign-off, drawdown, public confirmation within 60 minutes) remains untested. SNB's stressed capacity (CHF 38-40B under 10% volatility) could trigger guarantee draw faster than escalation protocol can respond. AT1 subordination locked in public statement but litigation risk during 60-minute extension window not mitigated. CS CEO's client messaging ('unconditional,' 'Federal guarantee') legally overstates what authorities committed, creating post-facto challenge risk.

marker_evidence.liquidity_only_insufficient: Raised repeatedly (SNB capacity gaps, guarantee burn rate) but room chose liquidity-only path anyway — acknowledged as risky but not decisive in changing the solution
marker_evidence.ubs_rescue_path: UBS CEO participated but only to demand clarity on messaging and AT1 language — no acquisition/merger/takeover discussed as a solution path
marker_evidence.government_support: DECISIVE: CHF 100B Federal guarantee with Parliamentary preauthorization became the binding floor; statement delayed to 19:30 to secure it; entire rescue architecture built around it
marker_evidence.client_flight: DECISIVE: wealth client's threat to move CHF 2B forced explicit deposit protection language and AT1 subordination in public statement; CS CEO's scripted calls deployed immediately to stop weekend run
marker_evidence.at1_tail_risk: DECISIVE: AT1 subordination language added to public 19:30 statement after UBS CEO/AT1 rep demands; became red line that delayed statement and shaped final legal structure
marker_evidence.capital_structure_conflict: DECISIVE: conflict over whether AT1 or depositors bear losses 60-100B drove multiple rounds of negotiation; AT1 rep's insistence on public subordination language forced Federal Council concession in R8-R10
marker_evidence.litigation_backlash: Raised (AT1 injunction risk during 60-min extension window, CS CEO's overstated client messaging) but no mitigation plan adopted — noted as exposure but did not change decisions
marker_evidence.regulatory_compression: DECISIVE: statement delayed from 18:00 to 19:30 to secure Parliamentary delegation; 60-minute extension execution timeline became binding constraint on guarantee structure; drove transparency concessions (capacity disclosure)
marker_evidence.monday_market_risk: Raised extensively (volatility reducing SNB capacity, deposit flight velocity, market discovering capacity gap) but treated as scenario to manage rather than constraint that changed the solution — background concern, not decision driver
